# Reference fixtures

Outputs of existing QFH calculators, used as test oracles. All mm / MHz.

| file           | source | c (mm·MHz) | rounding |
|----------------|--------|------------|----------|
| jcoppens.json  | jcoppens qfhcalc.js (2000, via web.archive.org; jcoppens.com offline) | 300000 | truncated 0.1 |
| shackwiki.json | https://shackwiki.com/assets/ant2.js ("after Coppens") | 299792.458 | 0.1 |
| recorded.json  | published values: rfwireless-world worked example, kaklik/QFH-Antenna parameters.scad | 300000 | as published |

All tools use the same Coppens algorithm; they differ in c and the clamping of conductor diameter
(>15 mm). jcoppens ignores its "length of one turn" input (`turnLength` here).

Grid: freq {137.5, 145.6, 435.5} × conductor/bend {7/15, 10.3/60, 6.9/30, 5/20, 10.3/50}
× turns {0.5, 0.75, 1} × D/H {0.3, 0.44}.

Fixtures were generated by re-running each reference algorithm, transcribed one-off.
The GPL sources are not vendored here.
